brief.p: Typical views per video in the last 12 months against the year before: story channels 0.84× (3 of 9 up), technical channels 0.78× (5 of 14 up) and personality channels 1.02× (3 of 5 up). Personality channels are holding up best. (Older videos have had longer to collect views, so a ratio near 1× means a channel kept its audience.)
Growing: Boxing Mania (45K → 258K), Fight Story (74K → 320K) and Mark Fighting (59K → 88K). Shrinking: Kombat Capital (150K → 8K), Sean "Muay Thai Guy" Fagan (26K → 7K) and Pro Striking (67K → 20K).

The 9 growing channels make mostly technical breakdowns (21%) and fighter profiles (18%); the 13 shrinking ones lean on technical breakdowns (29%) and fighter profiles (19%). Inside channels that mix formats, below their own usual: fighter profiles (0.84×) and lists and compilations (0.85×). Creators are making more technical breakdowns (23% → 26% of uploads) and less news and talk (15% → 11%) and tutorials (11% → 8%).
On story channels, 20–40 min videos beat the usual (1.24×); <10 min fall short (0.94×) and 10–20 min fall short (0.81×). Videos of 20+ minutes are 29% of uploads now, against 25% 3-4 years ago.
Titles that name a fighter do better (1.08× against 0.93×), titles that are about a woman fighter do better (2.24× against 0.98×) and titles that have a word in CAPS do better (1.03× against 0.96×).

Biggest jumps over a channel's usual in the last 4 months: "When they Put Young Mike Tyson against The Smash Machine" (Boxing Game, 13M, 232×), "Most Brutal MMA Fights of 2026 😳" (Die Hard Fighting, 3M, 171×) and "Alycia Baumgardner vs Bo Mi Re Shin Was BRUTAL 😳" (Die Hard Fighting, 1.7M, 126×).

Other creators' videos about these fighters are beating their channel's usual: Mona Kimura (8 videos, 24×), Smilla Sundell (3 videos, 15×), Roman Kryklia (2 videos, 11×) and Adrien Broner (4 videos, 8.1×).

Your last 10 uploads: median 34K views, typical length 11 min, 7 of 10 named a fighter in the title. Best: "Dagestan's Bruce Lee — The Perfect Fighter | Asadula Imangazaliev" (595K, 23× your usual). Your latest upload is 189 days old.

headline: Story channels are keeping their views better than technical ones (0.84× against 0.78×); the growing channels mostly make technical breakdowns; 20–40 min videos beat the usual on story channels; titles that are about a woman fighter do 2.24× their channel's usual.
